source_limitations: One supplier engineering drawing with front and section views, not independent photos. Supplier photo shows several sizes; not exact M8 dimension evidence.
units: One Blender unit represents 10 mm; no manufacturing certification.

reference_pipeline.mask_method: Source contour extraction with separately retained true bore; text not treated as geometry.

observed_repairs: Fit supplied correct annular topology but OD and thickness missed nominal dimensions. Projected existing loops to dimensioned radii and axial planes through persistent-ID typed edits.
12-sided raw cage visibly faceted; valid Gemini critic rejected it. Subdivided only circumferential edges, then projected new vertices to circles: 96 vertices, 96 quads, one closed component.

24-sided raw-cage critic feedback still requested smoothing. Three subsequent structured reviews failed validation; retained captured raw response diagnoses faceting but leaves below-threshold side scores without a localized mismatch. No review was treated as approval.
Isolated live bevel (0.005 units, 3 segments, 45-degree angle limit) then subdivision level 2 improved curvature. It shrank OD to 15.7993–15.8273 mm and bore to 8.2942–8.3100 mm.
Scaled outer and inner base loops separately using nominal/measured mean evaluated diameter, then reran the same live-modifier diagnostic. No modifier was applied.

final_evaluated_measurements.method: Independent Blender BVH, 360 radial samples at mid-thickness, axial thickness ray and through-bore ray

verification.agent_visual_review: Front and isometric Workbench/MatCap images inspected: circular outline, open bore, flat annular face and small continuous edge radius; not a material or production-quality verdict.

media_policy: Deleted all 10 review PNGs and 4 superseded blend checkpoints after inspection. Compact observations and measurements remain; deleted images cannot be used as available hash-bound review evidence. Source drawing, extraction inputs and final editable files remain local, not a Git media archive. Re-render before a new review; old review hashes are not current authority.
transfer_lesson: A selected fit is not dimensional correctness. A circular base cage does not guarantee a circular or correctly sized evaluated surface. Check outer and inner radii separately; inspect the intended modifier result without mistaking diagnostic access for acceptance.
next_step: Stage-aware independent cage/evaluated review; then a simple flanged spacer. No complex weapon or professional-capability claim from this exercise.
